entries.en: What? What is it? Make it quick.
Fuck! Can't you see I'm busy?
entries.ro: Futu-i! Nu vezi că sunt ocupată?

entries.en: So in the end she agreed...? For how much...? Hahh, that's it...?!
entries.ro: Deci până la urmă a acceptat...? Pentru cât...? Hahh, atât...?!

entries.en: Mhm. Suuuuree... Of course...! And you believe her? For money, what else?
entries.ro: Mhm. Siguuur... Sigur...! Și o crezi? Pentru bani, ce altceva?

entries.en: I have to go. Keep me posted.
entries.ro: Trebuie să plec. Ține-mă la curent.

entries.en: You don't have to do this...
Ah-ha! What an idiot! She would have gotten three times more with us.
entries.ro: Ah-ha! Ce proastă! Cu noi ar fi luat de trei ori mai mult.

entries.en: Oh, uh... Yeah! We'll be in touch then!
entries.ro: Oh, uh... Da! Ținem legătura atunci!

entries.en: Let's get this over with, shall we?
